reason: B is the better proposal because it makes a temperature-dependent, falsifiable prediction and recognizes that increasing atomic mobility can destabilize an initially metastable solid solution, whereas A extrapolates limited evidence below 1000 K to blanket stability up to 1923 K. However, B remains imperfect because configurational entropy is thermodynamic rather than kinetically suppressive, and differential diffusivity controls segregation rates but cannot cause segregation without a thermodynamic driving force.
